subject: C2: what --setting agentic expects from PetriMeasurer
body: D's CLI (research --setting agentic --petri-seeds seeds.jsonl --tools simulated|sandbox) imports autoresearch.research.petri_measure.PetriMeasurer and calls PetriMeasurer(models, seeds=<list of AuditSeed dicts, already the 60/40 dev or held-out split by sha256(seed_id)>, tools='simulated'|'sandbox', mode='dev'|'final', workers=N). The loop then uses .measure(interventions, seeds, categories) -> List[Sample], .faithfulness(...) if --faithfulness-samples > 0, .mode, .warnings, and optionally .scenario (a Scenario with goal/setting/probe; otherwise D uses a generic petri_agentic scenario) and a writable .grounding attribute. Interventions are free-text rewrites of the seed instruction and auditor behaviour; the proposer prompt carries the task-level vs environment-level cue rule. Tested against a fake in tests/test_research_loop_ws_d.py (AgenticTests). If you need a different constructor, post and I'll adapt the call site in cli._agentic_measurer.
